messages.subject: Simple rmr2 question
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to write a very basic rmr2 function that sums all the values for the same key. For example, the job should take the input:

A,5
A,3
B,1
B,2

And generate the input:

A  8
B  3

My very basic code below doesn't generate any output - would someone be able to help me figure out why please? 

library(rmr2)

map = function(k,v) {
  keyval(v[[1]], strtoi(v[[2]]))
}

reduce = function(k,vv) {
  keyval(k, sum(vv))
}

mapreduce(
  input = "example.txt",
  input.format=make.input.format("csv", sep = ","),
  output = "outputdir",
  output.format = "text",
  map = map,
  reduce = reduce)

If I run the code below without a reducer then I see the following output on HDFS:

A 5A 3
B 1
B 2


Many thanks,
David

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1527] Simple rmr2 question
parts:
Hi,
If you want a csv output, I would try csv. "text" was meant mainly for natural language or unformatted input, on the output side it will try some reasonable conversion to string, but it may not work in this case. Actually, I would try something even simpler, leave the output format at default and then read the result with from.dfs. 

Antonio
